theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Health Care (+2.08%) and Communication Svcs (+1.46%) led the market today, while Energy (-1.86%) and Utilities (-0.36%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.91%, defensives +0.86%, and value/cyclicals +0.14% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. That shows up at the index level too: the blue-chip Dow gained +0.81% while the tech-heavy Nasdaq fell -0.34%, a wide enough gap to matter. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up +0.84%, outperforming large caps. The VIX rose 0.06% to 16.86, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold added 0.11% to $4,170.20, crude oil was little changed at $96.20, and bitcoin gained 1.04% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
